tools.name: list_series
tools.description:
List the chapters AI Lifeline publishes (one entry per chapter page, from /api/index.json) with their page URL, API URL,
    the one-sentence answer line, the headline value (value, unit, date) and the series ids that belong to the chapter.
    region: optional filter, one of 'jp', 'us', 'eu', 'sg'.
